title: Uniswap-Fee-Cal
tagline: Uniswap Fee Calculator is a tool for you to get the approximated fee APR from every trading pair on Uniswap. Currently it supports Ethereum, Polygon, Optimism, and Arbitrum. Users can easily expand the supported trading pairs and chains by editing the config file.
description:
Uniswap Fee Calculator is a tool for you to get the approximated fee APR from every trading pair on Uniswap.
Currently it supports Ethereum, Polygon, Optimism, and Arbitrum. Users can easily expand the supported trading pairs and chains by editing the config file.
Prior to Uniswap Fee Calculator users can only get a blurb feeling about the APY that they are getting but now it solves the basic needs of many DeFi users.
how_its_made: I used apis from The Graph to calculate the fees accrued from each pool. In the past, users cannot fully understand the historical fee APR from any sort of Uniswap related projects. With this fee calculator, DeFi protocols can easily present the APR fees, and therefore use this fee to optimize the way they deploy liquidity.
